Description: Project budget (USD ceiling from SSM), alerts at 50/80/100% of actual spend and a deny action at 100% on the published enforced role names (design D10/D11, ENV-17, ENV-19). Part of the FinancialPlanning tooling stack (environment shared).

CostCeilingUsd.Description: Project cost ceiling in USD, read from SSM (initially 50).

NotificationEmail.Description: Human-configured budget notification target (kept in local untracked configuration).

Properties.Description: Attached by the budget action at 100% of the ceiling; only a human removes it.
Permission boundary for every beta role created by a finplan pipeline: denies other environments' tagged or named resources, live-financial actions and boundary/budget tampering (design D5).

Permission boundary for FinanceModel beta research and job-execution roles: the beta boundary plus denies on platform metadata, plan/publication/execution API writes and S3 writes outside research storage and the staging area (design D5, ENV-04).
Permission boundary for every gamma role created by a finplan pipeline: denies other environments' tagged or named resources, live-financial actions and boundary/budget tampering (design D5).

Permission boundary for FinanceModel gamma research and job-execution roles: the gamma boundary plus denies on platform metadata, plan/publication/execution API writes and S3 writes outside research storage and the staging area (design D5, ENV-04).
Permission boundary for every prod role created by a finplan pipeline: denies other environments' tagged or named resources, live-financial actions and boundary/budget tampering (design D5).

Permission boundary for FinanceModel prod research and job-execution roles: the prod boundary plus denies on platform metadata, plan/publication/execution API writes and S3 writes outside research storage and the staging area (design D5, ENV-04).
Permission boundary for account-level tooling roles (pipelines, budget action execution): live-financial deny and boundary/budget protection.

finplan.third_party_spend: TypeSafe Jev usage is billed from prepaid credits outside AWS and is not counted against the ceiling or any category.
